output.content: I checked the serving layer for the forecast service this morning. The endpoint is currently running on a manual request trigger. There is no automatic scaling or automated triggering in place. When the nightly job finishes, a human has to manually invoke the service to push the new predictions to the ordering system. If that step is missed, the stores fall back to last week's numbers. The infrastructure is stable, but the deployment path for the serving work remains entirely manual.
